## Welcome

We are a research group focused on computational biology and bioinformatics in the [School of Microbiology](https://www.udea.edu.co/wps/portal/udea/web/inicio/unidades-academicas/microbiologia) at the Universidad de Antioquia.
Our work aims to understand microbial communities, antimicrobial resistance,
and host-pathogen interactions through the lens of metagenomics, single-cell and genomic analysis.

## Research Areas

- **Metagenomics and resistome analysis** — characterization of antimicrobial 
  resistance genes in environmental and clinical samples.
- **Genomics and molecular epidemiology** — genomic, evolutionary, and 
  epidemiological characterization of bacterial pathogens.
- **Host-pathogen interactions** — using model organisms to study 
  bacteria-host dynamics.
